comment: Synthetic mutant for outer version-3 PreKey handshake acceptance: process_prekey_impl omits the CIPHERTEXT_MESSAGE_PRE_KYBER_VERSION rejection when starting a Bob session, accepting a PreKeySignalMessage whose outer version byte is downgraded from 0x44 (v4) to 0x33 (v3) while retaining Kyber fields 7 and 8.
